text:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged cutover now — sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. target model: v2.4.0, fallback: v2.3.1. canary slices enabled (5% each). tagging @maya for canary metrics
maya: got it. US canary started. p95=82ms, p50=18ms, error_rate=0.2% (mostly 429s), queue_depth_avg=12, warm_pool=6/8
liam: EU canary warming, traffic ramp to 5% in progress. no anomalies yet. apac warmers still initializing in ap-northeast-1
anil: quick reminder — playbook rule: if queue_depth > 40 OR rate_limit_errors > 1% in any region -> pin and rollback that region only. confirm we have pin prepared
maya: confirmed. prepared rollback pin command, tested in staging
jen_sre: setting automated guardrail: deploy-bot will auto-pin region on threshold and notify ops. threshold config posted below
```
# guardrail config snippet
- region: apac
  queue_depth_threshold: 40
  error_rate_threshold: 1.0
  auto_action: pin-to-version
  fallback_version: v2.3.1
```
ops_oncall: seeing occasional OOM traces in apac warmers (k8s events show container oomkilled x2). memory requests look normal though. gathering logs
deploy-bot: alert: apac queue_depth spiking: current=46 (threshold=40). starting 30s sampling window
liam: holding EU ramp at 5% until apac stabilizes. US continues at 5% canary
maya: running quick smoke on US conversational flows — ok. sample traces look consistent
paul_prod: release notes posted: https://internal/redwood/releases/v2.4.0 — callouts: tokenizer tweak, kv-cache micro-optimizations, known perf risk on long-seq workloads (APAC tested lower infra headroom)
anil: propose immediate soft-pin in APAC: lower traffic to 0% for v2.4.0, re-route APAC canary to v2.3.1, keep EU/US moving. anyone object?
jen_sre: +1. that avoids full rollback and keeps other regions progressing
ops_oncall: logs attached: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/apac-warmer --since=5m` shows repeated GC stalls ~80-120ms and 2 oomkilled events
maya: doing targeted cache warm restart for apac warmers (rolling restart, 1 pod at a time)
deploy-bot: executing command: `rolloutbot set-pin --region apac --version v2.3.1 --scope canary` — returning success
deploy-bot: routing update: APAC canary traffic -> v2.3.1, EU/US remain on v2.4.0 canary 5%
liam: EU looks green at 10m. p95=88ms, error_rate<0.1%. proceed to staged ramp to 15% in 10m unless we see backpressure
maya: US steady. no further 429 spikes
ops_oncall: apac warmers restarting completed, no new oom events in last 4m. queue_depth dropped to 18
paul_prod: note for release notes: add APAC soft-pin explanation and mitigation steps (memory tuning + kv-cache warm strategy)
anil: timeline check: next checkpoint +15m from now for full regional decision. if APAC recovers we'll resume APAC rollout otherwise keep pinned and schedule postmortem action item
maya: ack. monitoring dashboards: https://internal/redwood/dashboards/cutover-3924500000
deploy-bot: canaries: US=5% (v2.4.0), EU=15% (v2.4.0), APAC pinned to v2.3.1 (canary 0% for v2.4.0). next automated check in 15m. notify @ops_oncall @jen_sre on any threshold crosses
ops_oncall: watching. will escalate to infra if memory pattern returns
liam: thanks team — documenting decisions in the rollout thread and will update release notes after checkpoint
maya: +1, will paste final metrics after checkpoint
deploy-bot: thread checkpoint recorded. session id: cutover-3924500000 | first_message_ts=3924500000 | last_message_ts=3924500120
